title: Entropy-weighted interpolation gives a linear inverse-advantage field guard

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. First ties; fallback output0,t_N=u_N=d_plan=N+1.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For every fully guarded candidate, source_certificate computes u(p) as the minimum of original geometry d_plan, common-S certificate, and weighted certificate c_H+1+sum_u[T_u(S_u-1)+(O-1)], with O=rank+maxTheta+1 and S_u=rank+max(Y_childdepth,maxTheta+1)+3 from actual scalar recurrence SEL1. At the selected plan exact POS/DP threshold t_N<=u_N<=d_plan; C_B2(J_N)>=4N-8t_N+8>=4N-8u_N+8 for EVERY integer N>=0. At EVERY sufficiently large integer N, u_N<=2^ceil(D_energy Z), D_energy=279721/100000=2.79721, Z=ceil(L^(3/4))*ceil(B^(1/4)),L=ceil(log2 N),B=ceil(log2(L+1)). Consequently for each fixed epsilon>0, C_B2(J_N)>=4N-N^epsilon at ALL sufficiently large integer lengths, and this SAME fixed family has liminf C_B2(J_N)/N>=4.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
